intended_object: A canonical isomorphism, built from identities, between the short complex `X_i → X_j → X_k` of the alternating constant complex at an even index `j` and the short complex `A --ψ--> A --φ--> A`. It is inferred from the docstring and from how the module uses it to compute homology.
explanation:
This is not a mathematical notion. It is an auxiliary isomorphism of short complexes that the module needs to compute the homology of `alternatingConst`. It is still correct and matches its docstring.

In `alternatingConst`, the differential `d i j` is `φ` when `i` is even and `ψ` when `i` is odd. Because related indices have opposite parity, `j` even forces `i` odd, so `d i j = ψ`, and `d j k = φ`. So the short complex `sc' i j k` really is `A --ψ--> A --φ--> A`, and the isomorphism has identity components.

There is no general mathematical object here to compare against or to generalize. The definition is internal plumbing for the homology computation.
